presets.name: Halo Orbit
presets.notes: Immediate quarter/eighth/sixteenth all-head echo with middle feedback, a restrained Cloud tail, and a moving Independent constellation. Output stays at the 0.5 default.

presets.name: SubSafe Orbit
presets.notes: Half-, quarter-, and eighth-note repeats stay above a 260 Hz spatial crossover, with a slow low-depth Linked orbit and a compact Spring tail.

presets.name: Triplet Air Anchor
presets.notes: Quarter-, eighth-, and sixteenth-note triplets climb through three Independent heights while a transport-locked Figure-8 cascade stays audible at load.

presets.name: Vocal Halo Doubler
presets.notes: A 70/105 ms two-head Linear doubler uses close Independent positions and a short wide Cloud halo without adding Ping-Pong motion.

presets.name: Slap Tighten
presets.notes: A single approximately 76 ms Warm slap with low but nonzero feedback tightens a source without spatial or reverb smearing.

presets.name: Dotted 8 Grid
presets.notes: Dotted-eighth, eighth, and sixteenth heads form a static three-position Independent grid with clear middle feedback and a low Spring return.

presets.name: Clean PingPong Throw
presets.notes: A clean eighth/dotted-eighth two-head throw exposes the Ping-Pong topology directly, with a short Spring return and no spatial convolution.

presets.name: Dotted 8 Lead Throw
presets.notes: A dotted-eighth lead repeat and supporting eighth-note head stay at a fixed right-front position with a ducked Cloud halo.

presets.name: Wide Filter Throw
presets.notes: A dark Cassette throw spreads Golden-ratio heads across an Independent field while a moderate Constellation pendulum moves at load.

presets.name: Dust Carousel
presets.notes: Cassette dust, Golden-ratio head spacing, and a high-spread Independent Cascade orbit make the carousel audible from the stored state.

presets.name: Wander Morph
presets.notes: A restrained Independent Wander morphs Linear-spaced Warm repeats through a 45 percent Constellation without destabilizing the center.

presets.name: PingPong Tunnel
presets.notes: Quarter, eighth, and dotted-eighth Ping-Pong repeats occupy increasing Independent distances while a full-spread Cascade breathes the tunnel.

presets.name: Tape Drift Atmos
presets.notes: Driven Cassette heads, a modulated Cloud bed, and a slow Independent Wander produce audible drift from the stored state alone.

presets.name: Dark Spring Room
presets.notes: A fixed left-front dark Spring room uses reverb-only mode, a finite decay, and moderate width; no echo or motion behavior is implied.

presets.name: Whole-Note Ambient
presets.notes: Quarter-, half-, and whole-note heads feed a wide Cloud while transport-locked Independent Breathe phases expand the ambient field.

presets.name: Dub Spiral Feedback
presets.notes: Hot Golden-ratio repeats use high but sub-threshold feedback and an Independent Cascade orbit for a spiral present at load.

presets.name: Echo Into Spring
presets.notes: A medium-feedback Hot echo enters a calibrated Spring serial route with no legacy reverb-level compensation and no inert motion story.

presets.name: Infinite Pad Ride
presets.notes: Near-sustain feedback remains below 0.90 while quarter-, half-, and whole-note heads ride a long Cloud through a slow Independent Wander.

presets.name: Golden Gallop Drive
presets.notes: Golden-ratio free-time heads, driven Hot tape, and a transport-locked triplet Pendulum Cascade produce the gallop at load.

presets.name: Bright Glitch Echo
presets.notes: Clean sixteenth and thirty-second heads with a bright input tilt and middle feedback create the glitch rhythm without inert reverb or motion claims.

presets.name: Broken Loop Dropout
presets.notes: Worn tape dropout, high middle feedback, and a full-spread Independent Wander break a Linear three-head loop from the stored state.

presets.name: Helix Surge
presets.notes: Renamed from Helix Rise: a transport-locked, full-depth Independent Cascade orbit creates a repeating surge immediately after load.

presets.name: Hard Lock Drop Hits
presets.notes: A transport-synced sixteenth Hot hit uses all three spatial UI locks, a fixed near-below position, and a short Spring impact with audible feedback.

presets.name: Rush 16 Fill
presets.notes: Sixteenth and sixteenth-triplet heads, baked 0.58 feedback, and a transport-locked Independent Pendulum create the complete fill at load.

presets.name: Externalizer Wash
presets.notes: A wide lateral Cloud wash at 65 degrees and 3 m externalizes the reverb-only field without relying on motion or silent echo controls.

presets.name: Crossover Clarity
presets.notes: A 280 Hz spatial crossover leaves low frequencies on the dry bypass while clean middle-feedback repeats sit at a fixed right-front position.

presets.name: Elevation Cue
presets.notes: A fixed 45-degree elevation and bright wide Cloud provide the named elevation cue at load, correcting the former zero-elevation contradiction.

presets.name: Envelopment Hall
presets.notes: A 70/105/140 ms Linear early-head grid feeds a wide Cloud while a full-spread Independent Constellation orbit supplies envelopment.

presets.name: Motion Tracker Clean
presets.notes: A slow 0.08 Hz Linked orbit, clean tape, and a low Spring return keep one trackable motion path against clear middle-feedback repeats.

presets.name: Ping-Pong Ricochet
presets.notes: Quarter, dotted-eighth, and eighth-triplet Ping-Pong heads ricochet through three Independent points on a full-spread transport-locked Cascade.

presets.name: Cloud Packets
presets.notes: A compact Cloud enters half-, dotted-half-, and whole-note echo heads. Low feedback and a subdued direct reverb return separate soft packets across three fixed positions.

presets.name: Forest Afterglow
presets.notes: Softened quarter-, dotted-quarter-, and half-note echoes feed a lingering Cloud tail. Fixed Independent heads and restrained warm tape keep sparse guitar and keys readable.

presets.name: Crosscurrent
presets.notes: An eighth-note reply crosses eighth- and quarter-note triplet heads at low feedback. Three fixed positions and minimal Cloud support retain a clear straight/triplet pattern.

presets.name: Offbeat Weave
presets.notes: Dotted-sixteenth, straight-eighth, and dotted-quarter heads add a short offset and a later answer to dry grooves. Low feedback, restrained warmth and quiet Spring support limit crowding.

presets.name: Velvet Answer
presets.notes: Warm quarter- and dotted-quarter echoes feed a moderate Cloud tail from two fixed front-side positions. Dry-keyed ducking softens the direct reverb during playing while echo replies remain audible.

presets.name: Pond Round
presets.notes: Three evenly spaced answers on an eighth-triplet grid occupy fixed left, front and right-side positions. Minimal regeneration and quiet Cloud support preserve the turn-taking pattern for isolated mallets and stabs.

presets.name: Distant Lantern
presets.notes: Half-triplet, half-, and dotted-half-note echo heads sit at 3.2, 4.2 and 5.2 m relative to an unspatialized dry foreground. Low regeneration and a wider unpositioned Cloud tail suggest subdued melodic answers.

presets.name: Spring Aftershock
presets.notes: A short, focused Spring enters eighth-, dotted-eighth-, and quarter-note echoes. Low feedback and three fixed front positions return the spring attack in successive percussive aftershocks.

presets.name: Bass Reply
presets.notes: One clean eighth-note reply answers an upper-bass hit from a fixed slight side position. Zero regeneration, cut echo bass and restrained branch level keep the answer finite; no reverb is active.

presets.name: Hat Ghost Triplets
presets.notes: Two quiet first-pass ticks from H2 and H3 at thirty-second and sixteenth triplet divisions ornament each supplied hat accent. Zero regeneration, clean tape and fixed close side positions add no reverb tail.

presets.name: Quarter Adlib
presets.notes: A warm straight-quarter vocal echo repeats briefly from a fixed right-side head. Cut echo shelves and a restrained branch trim leave a discrete answer without reverb or input-keyed echo ducking.

presets.name: Halfstep Shadow
presets.notes: A quiet warm quarter-note echo adds short percussion answers to sparse grooves. Spatial processing, PingPong and reverb are off; the supplied stereo layout is retained.

presets.name: Riddim Pocket Room
presets.notes: A compact reverb-only Cloud room adds a quiet diffuse space around upper-bass stabs. The 8 ms pre-delay and dry-keyed direct reverb ducking retain attack detail without discrete echo copies or spatial processing.

presets.name: Lead Gap Cloud
presets.notes: A wide reverb-only Cloud tail becomes less prominent during lead notes through dry-keyed direct reverb ducking. Moderate decay and 16 ms pre-delay support separated pitched stabs; no echo copies or spatial processing are active.

presets.name: Canon Windows
presets.notes: Clean first-pass melodic copies enter two and four host beats later from fixed equal-distance left and right heads. Flat echo shelves, zero regeneration and no reverb preserve the supplied line for delayed imitation.

presets.name: Bell Counterphrase
presets.notes: A dark warm answer returns three host beats after a supplied bell or pluck, from a fixed left-side head at 2 m. Very low regeneration and no reverb leave a late melodic counterphrase rather than a continuous bed.

presets.name: Concrete Chatter
presets.notes: Experiment: unsynced clean echoes near 90 ms make percussion chatter with moderate regeneration and cuts to both shelves. No spatial processing or reverb is active; architectural flutter is an inspiration rather than a geometry model.

presets.name: Hidden Rhythm
presets.notes: Experiment: a clean quarter-note copy of a supplied patterned input returns from a fixed right-side head. Flat shelves, zero regeneration and no reverb isolate a rhythmic grouping comparison; the preset generates no input pattern.

presets.name: Static Sweep
presets.notes: Experiment: sixteenth-triplet and straight-sixteenth copies arrive at two fixed equal-distance positions near the center. A wet-only return, clean tape, flat shelves, zero regeneration and no reverb test apparent travel from short supplied events without a moving trajectory.

presets.name: Spatial Pull
presets.notes: Experiment: thirty-second, sixteenth and dotted-sixteenth first-pass copies use left-left-right fixed positions at equal distance. Zero regeneration and clean flat echo treatment accompany a minimum-decay Cloud at minus 12 dB, leaving residual ambience in the required all-head mode.

presets.name: Point Orbit
presets.notes: One clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy follows a full azimuth orbit at 0.16 Hz. One percent trajectory depth retains almost constant height and radius; focused source width and zero regeneration expose the supplied sound rather than multiplying it.

presets.name: Beat Orbit
presets.notes: One clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy follows a whole-note azimuth orbit with transport restart. One percent depth limits height and radius excursions. A sustained supplied sound supports following the path; short isolated hits sample locations instead.

presets.name: Front Swing
presets.notes: One clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy moves through the frontal azimuth arc from minus 60 to plus 60 degrees at 0.20 Hz, at fixed height and distance. Focused source width and zero regeneration expose the lateral path.

presets.name: Near Ear Pass
presets.notes: One clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy crosses the frontal minus 60 to plus 60 degree arc at 0.24 Hz with a 0.35 m distance control. Zero regeneration and focused width expose the near-field cue treatment; this is a fixed-radius pass without Doppler.

presets.name: Side Relay
presets.notes: Two clean first-pass replies at an eighth and a dotted quarter occupy minus 75 and plus 75 degrees at equal height and distance. Ninety percent wet Mix leaves a small dry contribution; zero regeneration and no added reverb keep isolated supplied notes separate.

presets.name: Orbit Replies
presets.notes: Two clean wet-only first-pass replies at an eighth and a dotted quarter use Independent heads in a 0.10 Hz azimuth orbit. Full Cascade spread offsets their trajectory phases; one percent depth limits height and radius movement. Isolated supplied notes keep the two replies apart.

presets.name: Approach Retreat
presets.notes: One clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy stays at 75 degrees while Breathe cycles the distance control from 0.4 to 3.4 m at 0.16 Hz. Focused width and zero regeneration expose level, near-field, absorption and intrinsic reflection changes; the distance model is artistic, without Doppler.

presets.name: Near Far Relay
presets.notes: Two clean wet-only first-pass replies at an eighth and a dotted quarter stay at the same 75 degree azimuth and zero elevation while their distance controls differ at 0.4 and 4 m. Zero regeneration and focused width isolate the contrasting artistic distance treatments.

presets.name: Rear Window
presets.notes: Experiment: one clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy moves through the rear-centered plus or minus 60 degree arc at 0.16 Hz. Zero regeneration and focused width expose the rear-direction HRTF cues. A listener may instead hear a frontal arc with the generic dataset.

presets.name: Front Back Relay
presets.notes: Experiment: two clean wet-only first-pass replies at an eighth and a dotted quarter occupy zero and 180 degree azimuth at equal height and distance. Zero regeneration and focused width isolate front/rear spectral treatment; perceptual front/back separation is listener-dependent.

presets.name: Height Relay
presets.notes: Experiment: two clean wet-only first-pass replies at an eighth and a dotted quarter share 45 degree azimuth and 1.1 m distance while elevations differ at minus 35 and plus 55 degrees. Zero regeneration and focused width preserve the HRTF spectral comparison; perceived height varies by listener.

presets.name: Sky Figure Eight
presets.notes: Experiment: one clean wet-only 70 ms H1 copy follows Figure-8 at 0.12 Hz and 85 percent depth. Azimuth and elevation control excursions reach plus or minus 51 degrees, with elevation cycling twice per horizontal cycle. Focused width and zero regeneration expose a single trajectory rather than a diffuse field; audible height remains listener-dependent.
